name: Giant Coua
rangeDescription: Thinly distributed in forest and savanna of western and southern madagascar
description: Huge, long-tailed, long-legged bird. Rufous belly and blue-and-pink bare facial skin.

name: Sierra Madre Ground-Warbler
rangeDescription: Northeastern luzon (philippines)
description: A medium-sized bird of the forest floor from the lowlands to low elevations in the mountains in northeastern Luzon. Fairly stout, with a pale lower bill, long legs, and large feet.

name: Chestnut-bellied Malkoha
rangeDescription: Southern myanmar, southern thailand, malay peninsula, sumatra, and borneo
description: Large, rather ungainly cuckoo; clambers about in the middle and upper levels of lowland forests and edges as it forages. Glossy green above, gray below and on head, with neon-orange skin around the eye, chestnut-orange belly and undertail coverts, greenish-yellow bill, and white-tipped green tail.

name: Daurian Jackdaw
rangeDescription: Southern siberia to mongolia, northern china, and southeastern tibet; winters to southern china
description: Small stout crow; often seen in large flocks, sometimes with other crows. Adult’s white neck and belly are unique in the region.

name: White-winged Guan
rangeDescription: Dry forest of northwestern peru (tumbes, piura and lambayeque)
description: Large, turkey-like bird restricted to dry forests of northwestern Peru. Dark brown overall, with a red wattle, a pink face patch, and white scaling on the breast.

name: Thick-billed Spiderhunter
rangeDescription: Forest of peninsular thailand, malay peninsula, sumatra, and borneo
description: Dull and largely unmarked spiderhunter. Brownish olive above with a yellow belly, faint yellow crescents around the eye, and faint speckling on the crown.

name: Green-throated Euphonia
rangeDescription: Lowlands of eastern paraguay to southeastern brazil and northeastern argentina
description: Tiny bird with a strong thick bill and a short tail. Males are mostly glossy dark greenish-blue with a yellow band on the forehead and are entirely yellow below.

name: Pelzeln's Tody-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Northwestern brazil (locally on rio negro and tributaries)
description: Very small flycatcher with an olive-green back; white below with thin gray streaks. Note the whitish wingbars.

name: Moorland Francolin
rangeDescription: Montane moorlands of central and southern ethiopia
description: A pretty, intricately marked medium-sized francolin. The white throat is spotted with black, and the wings show large rufous patches in flight.

name: Red-faced Parrot
rangeDescription: Andes of southwestern ecuador and adjacent northwestern peru
description: Rare and threatened parrot found only in high Andean forest in southern Ecuador and adjacent parts of northern Peru. Small compared to most other parrots.

name: Flame-crowned Manakin
rangeDescription: Amazonian brazil (south of the amazon river), far southeastern peru, and northern and northeastern bolivia
description: Fairly large manakin. Males are distinctive, with a black head and an orange-red center of the crown that is often concealed; upperparts olive and underparts rusty, contrasting with a pure white throat.

name: Pacific Tuftedcheek
rangeDescription: West slope of western andes of southwestern colombia and western ecuador
description: Handsome arboreal bird restricted to wet cloud forest in the western Andes. Its conspicuous neck tufts are often tinged with buff and can be flared out if the bird is excited or agitated.

name: Snowy-throated Babbler
rangeDescription: Mountains of northeastern india (northeastern assam and southeastern arunachal pradesh)
description: A small, dark brown bird with a contrastingly black-and-white face. The black cheeks are sandwiched between a long, thick white eyebrow and a white throat.

name: Aldabra White-eye
rangeDescription: Aldabra and astove islands (indian ocean)
description: A small, sharp-billed warbler-like bird. Note the yellow patches on the throat and undertail and the white spectacles around the eye.

name: Germain's Peacock-Pheasant
rangeDescription: Humid forest of southern vietnam
description: Small compact brown pheasant with bright red facial skin and iridescent sapphire spots all over the body, with longer green spots on the tail. Inhabits forests with dense cover from the lowlands up into the foothills and lower montane areas.

name: Cape Verde Storm-Petrel
rangeDescription: Breeds in winter on cape verde islands; extent of at-sea range unknown, possibly to eastern north america
description: Very similar to Band-rumped and Monteiro's Storm-Petrels, and closely related to those taxa. Breeds only on Cape Verde islands.

name: Audouin's Gull
rangeDescription: Mediterranean basin; winters to senegambia
description: Elegant slim gull with long legs, and narrow wings. Adults have a light grey body with a paler white head.

name: Yellow-throated Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Tasmania, king island, and furneaux group (bass strait)
description: Medium-large honeyeater with bright yellow throat. Back is olive green, head and breast are gray.

name: Rufous-backed Antvireo
rangeDescription: Coastal mountains of southeastern brazil (rio de janeiro to paraná)
description: Big headed antbird with a heavy hooked bill and a shortish tail. Rufous above and pale below with a gray neck and face dappled with white spots.

name: Auckland Islands Teal
rangeDescription: Islets of auckland islands (ewing, enderby, rose, ocean, adams, disappointment, and dundas); formerly auckland island
description: Small, flightless dark brown duck, endemic to New Zealand. Males have green iridescence on head, dark chestnut-colored breast, and lightly barred flanks.
